author: control_timers
decision: A separate data-only C typed encoder is a justified next hypothesis. Preserve the original digest call position and every caller guard. Do not install or launch an all-day audit from this design.

actual_evidence.review: Read only the small result and hash. No real input gzip or saved outcome reread.
actual_evidence.interpretation: B is the original validator with instrumentation, not an optimization. These two absent paths support investigating encoding cost; they do not establish successful full-coverage guard cost, activation frequency, whole-audit attribution or a speedup from A/B differences.
actual_evidence.prior_negative: Python batched writer retained exact bytes but whole-tree preflight made fixed inputs slower: 27212 A28.7789/B70.9182 ms;27215 A48.73495/B115.8761 ms. Keep this negative; do not remove safety checks to improve numbers.

minimal_interface.extension: A distinct CPython3.11.9 extension exposing try_typed_bytes(body) and a closed ABI/domain contract. Return fresh bytes, or NotImplemented only after a hook-free unsupported attempt. Never return partial bytes.
minimal_interface.python_wrapper: Verify extension identity and frozen original code identities. If the result is NotImplemented, call the original capture_digest_v2 exactly once. Otherwise apply the existing Python hashlib.sha256(...).hexdigest(); keep SHA and wrapper costs in the measured call. A separate diagnostic bytes oracle exposes complete original bytes for conformance.
minimal_interface.no_authority: Bytes or digest equality grant no capture provenance, freshness, owner, native session, routing or simulator authority. No native simulation library is linked.
minimal_interface.no_state_cache: No input, snapshot, digest, candidate or label persists between calls. Only fixed field-name constants and executable code may persist.

single_pass_algorithm: Follow both frozen writer functions in exact source consumption order: namespace strings, outer schema, all local fields and arrays, extension receipts/completion/action coverage and ACK presence. Preserve every array order and length prefix, including duplicate identities.

At each visited mapping require exact dict, then scan that mapping's key types with PyDict_Next before any lookup. Every key must be exact str on the fast path. This prevents a stored custom key's equality/hash callback during lookup. Do not recursively preflight all values or unused subtrees.

Use exact list for fast-path sequences and exact dictionary entries. Tuples, subclasses and arbitrary iterators are unsupported and fall back without invoking len/iteration/getitem hooks. The declared fast domain is stable input with the GIL held; concurrent mutation and arbitrary runtime callbacks are not claimed equivalent.

Process one field before gathering later fields. On missing field or unsupported representation, discard the private buffer and return NotImplemented without a pending exception. The original traversal then determines the precise error order. Do not clear a real encoding/allocation error and retry.

Append bytes to a private checked-size buffer, using fixed-width stack scratch for numbers. No Python struct.pack call or per-number Python bytes object is needed. Check addition/growth overflow before every append; catch C++ allocation/length exceptions and convert to a failing Python exception, never C++ unwinding through the C ABI.
Finish with one owned bytes result. Keep all partial-buffer cleanup local. Do not release the GIL, return input references, or maintain a request cache.

wire_primitives.text: Exact str only. Strict UTF-8 once per consumed field, then unsigned 64-bit big-endian byte length and exact bytes. Embedded NUL and astral codepoints are legal. A surrogate encoding error propagates; no replacement, normalization or ensure_ascii transformation.
wire_primitives.uint64: Exact int and bool only. Use a 64-bit unsigned-long-long mask conversion after type checks; emit eight explicit big-endian bytes. Negative and arbitrarily large integers retain the original modulo 2^64 behavior. Verify sizeof/CHAR_BIT assumptions in the extension contract.
wire_primitives.double: Exact float, bool, and a conservative exact-int range only. For floats use the same PyFloat_Pack8(...,0) routine as CPython3.11.9 _struct's >d. Preserve -0, NaN payload/sign as produced by that same routine, and infinities. For ints first prove a signed64 range without supplied hooks, then use PyLong_AsDouble and PyFloat_Pack8. Larger ints return NotImplemented before conversion. This avoids silently changing _struct's conversion-error rewriting into a raw OverflowError.
wire_primitives.boolean: Minimal fast path accepts exact bool, writing 0 or1. Other truthy/falsy values fall back before __bool__ or __len__ can run. The original's more permissive truthiness is not replaced by a new rejection.
wire_primitives.ACK_presence: Preserve the original identity check ack is not None, then the exact dictionary fast path for a present ACK. Do not replace it with truthiness.

fallback_and_errors: Check types through exact C type predicates, not Python equality, isinstance protocols or conversions. Never call supplied __and__, __index__, __float__, __bool__, __len__, __iter__, __getitem__, encode, hash or equality on an unsupported object before fallback.

The no-hook property applies to all supplied objects encountered before unsupported, including dictionary keys. Scanning a later custom key early is permitted only because it triggers no hook and the original function will then run once from its true beginning.

Unused values are not traversed. An unused custom object or alias may remain ignored exactly as in the original finite-field writer. Do not claim this proves a fully validated JSON tree. Shared consumed aliases are read repeatedly and remain legal; no generic cycle rejection is added to a writer that does not have one.

Unsupported is the sole fallback trigger. Unicode errors, MemoryError, pending exceptions, buffer overflow and unexpected internal errors remain failures/unknown. Fallback must not mask these or produce an accepted digest from a partial buffer.

Successful bytes and original unsupported-path effects are conformance targets. Memory pressure, recursion/interrupt timing, allocation points and arbitrary mutation schedules are not promised identical; every such failure remains retained unknown.
required_focused_gate_before_cost: Complete bytes equality against the unchanged original outer/local code with only the final SHA facade replaced; hashing alone is insufficient. Also require digest equality.

All fields populated; empty/nonempty lists; both ACK cases; repeated identities; reordered arrays; per-field mutations; missing fields at early and late positions; negative/arbitrary-size integer masks; bool in integer/double positions; supported and unsupported truthy slots.

Double boundary/rounding cases, positive and negative zero, subnormals, infinities and multiple NaN bit patterns. Huge-int double fields must take one original fallback and preserve its exception class/message/order.
Unicode ASCII/multibyte/NUL/astral and paired/unpaired surrogate failures. Earlier bad encoding versus later missing field must preserve the original first failure.

Custom scalar/str/int/container subclasses and dictionary keys with hook counters/raising hooks: zero hooks in the C attempt and exactly original effects in one fallback. Include ignored extra custom values, stored custom keys, cycles in unused values and consumed malformed positions.
No mutable input or buffer alias escapes; unchanged input identity/content; no persisted request references; failure cleanup; injected allocation/resource failure is unknown and is not retried.
Bind actual extension binary, compiler/runtime/header/source closure, source function/code identity and contract. Test the staged prepare-to-execute lifecycle, not only isolated helper functions.

Only after source and synthetic gates, a separately approved fixed-two-actual-input test must verify every envelope in original order and full bytes before any ABBA timing. Startup, safe-key scans, encode, wrapper fallback, SHA, outputs and reread all remain inside the owned budget.
integration_constraints: Preserve research_original_low_wip.delivered_peer's schema/owner checks, then complete digest, then finite/causality/expiry checks, then coverage/authority checks. In particular do not move expiry ahead of digest.

Do not edit frozen writer, batched candidate, original C normalizer, native026/027 archives, policy modules or simulator build. Use a new stand-alone extension/build directory and an explicit private binder only after independent review.

A source-derived descriptor/inventory of every text/integer/float/bool/loop operation should be frozen against the original AST so a handwritten C loop cannot silently omit a field. This is additional evidence; complete byte conformance remains required.
The measured validator result justifies a local C experiment; it does not justify another full600 bridge audit or any claim that an all-day certificate will close.

primary_sources_consulted.relevance: Pinned bp_double converts with PyFloat_AsDouble, replaces conversion failure with StructError, and packs using PyFloat_Pack8 with big-endian flag0. This is why unrestricted integer conversion cannot silently substitute a different error.
Documents modulo conversion and potential __index__ use. Exact-type checks are required before calling it. The rolling3.11 documentation is API context, not proof of the future3.11.9 binary identity.
Documents byte order, IEEE-format packing and platform limitations. The future prototype must remain pinned to the original interpreter/runtime rather than claim all-platform bit equivalence.
